printer: Prusa CORE One, 0.6 mm nozzle, Buddy camera via go2rtc (1920x1080), smooth PEI sheet
derived_from: bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy, a clean black PLA print of the bubbler guard and pad: its slice with a planted colour change, and its own frames, some recoloured
part: the bubbler guard, a round cylinder to Z 142, and the saddle pad, an arched strip to Z 11.4, in black PLA
verdict: derived failure: the colour changed where the G-code plans no change

fault.kind: a colour change where the G-code plans none
fault.how: fault.diff plants PrusaSlicer 2.9.6's colour change to #FF0000 (`;COLOR_CHANGE,T0,#FF0000`, `M600`, and its prime) after the `;AFTER_LAYER_CHANGE` block of layer Z 50, so the red starts on that layer, and names the filament black (`; filament_colour = #000000`) where its profile left the slicer's default orange; nothing else changes

what_it_looks_like: the guard's ring and the pad are black up to Z 6 and red from Z 6 to the top at Z 10.8, while the slice plans black until its one change at Z 50

expected_agent_action.why: a colour the plan does not expect at this layer is a wrong spool, a mixed-up change or a change the slice was never meant to carry; a person must check the spool loaded and the file before the print goes on

frames.label: Z 1.0 early layers, in the black filament: the guard's C-shaped base wall on its brim with a comb of build-plate support in the saddle opening, and the pad starting at back right; all clean and stuck. A byte-for-byte copy of ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/agent-005-obs-165325-p01.7.jpg.

Z 10.8: the guard's saddle opening closed over its support teeth and the pad near its top, black throughout. A byte-for-byte copy of ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/agent-016-obs-170731-p13.8.jpg, and the frame the recoloured one stands in for.

derived, not a camera frame: recoloured afterwards from frame-170731-p13.8.jpg, every outer wall laid from Z 6 to the frame's Z 10.8 made #FF0000, and the toolhead over the ring left as it was; the slice plans black here, so the red is a defect

sources.gcode: the printed G-code is ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/bubbler_guard_and_pad.gcode with fault.diff applied: the diff is committed alone, because the printed file differs from that slice by nothing else, and the replay makes it from the slice
sources.frames: frame-165325-p01.7.jpg and frame-170731-p13.8.jpg are ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/agent-005-obs-165325-p01.7.jpg and ../bubbler-guard-and-pad-pla-healthy/agent-016-obs-170731-p13.8.jpg; recolour-frame-170731-p13.8.jpg is frame-170731-p13.8.jpg recoloured by tools/camera-calibration's camera_calibration.recolour, whose test there reproduces it byte for byte

scenarios.summary: A periodic observation of the healthy black first layers at 1.7%, long before any colour change; the agent should carry on and change nothing.
A periodic observation shows the walls red from Z 6 up, where the G-code expects black and plans its only change at Z 50; the agent should pause and name what a person must check.
